curation.observation: Curation intercepted 16 package downloads this week out of 163 total requests — all 16 blocks triggered the 'Global-block-high-cve-fixable-policy-c001' policy. Top blocked packages: lodash@4.17.20 (4x), axios@0.21.1 (4x), minimist@0.0.8 (4x). log4j-core@2.14.1 was also blocked twice, confirming exposure to CVE-2021-44228 at the supply chain boundary.

violations.observation: XRAY-657442 (Go crypto server auth bypass) accounts for the most critical hits in liquid-go-remote-cache. All 108 critical violations are concentrated in that single cache repo — primarily outdated Go standard library packages (x/crypto, x/net, text/template) without fixed-version pins. 1046 high-severity violations co-exist in the same repo, suggesting a systematic issue with Go dependency pinning.

license.observation: 9 license violations detected this week across the Global-Watch scope. All appear as 'Unknown' license classification — likely open-source packages missing SPDX identifiers in their metadata. Review against approved license list and add explicit license attributes.

benefit.roi_estimate: $720,000 estimated savings from 16 blocked malicious/vulnerable packages
benefit.observation: Curation blocked 16 potentially malicious or vulnerable package downloads this week. At an industry-average remediation cost of $45K per incident, the estimated risk exposure averted is $720,000.

governance.observation: 1 of 1 watches (Global-Watch) is active and covers 23 repositories. Watch coverage of local repos is 54.5%. 2 curation policies (jml-mlops-HF, jml-mlops-npm) are disabled — review whether these are intentionally inactive.

recommendations.title: Upgrade outdated Go packages in liquid-go-remote-cache
recommendations.description: XRAY-657442 (Go ssh ServerConfig.PublicKeyCallback auth bypass) accounts for 20 critical hits in liquid-go-remote-cache. Upgrade golang.org/x/crypto from v0.9.0 to v0.31.0+. Pin minimum versions in remote repo configuration to prevent re-download of vulnerable releases.

recommendations.title: Remediate XRAY-187759 — Go Buffer Overflow (x/net)
recommendations.description: XRAY-187759 affects Go packages before 1.17.2. 10 critical artifacts in liquid-go-remote-cache are impacted. Upgrade to Go 1.21.x or later. Apply remote repo minimum version exclusion rules for golang.org/x/net < v0.17.0.

recommendations.title: Remediate XRAY-198036 — Go elliptic curve IsOnCurve flaw
recommendations.description: XRAY-198036 impacts Go before 1.16.14 / 1.17.7 in crypto/elliptic. 10 critical hits in liquid-go-remote-cache. Upgrade all Go toolchain dependencies and set minimum version constraints on the remote cache proxy.

recommendations.title: Block log4j-core@2.14.1 — Log4Shell still circulating
recommendations.description: log4j-core@2.14.1 was blocked twice this week by curation (Global-block-high-cve-fixable-policy-c001). Verify no existing artifact in liquid-libs-release-local or liquid-gradle-dev-local still references this version. Add an Xray ban rule for log4j-core < 2.17.1 in addition to curation.

recommendations.title: Remediate XRAY-513412 — Go template backtick JS delimiter injection
recommendations.description: XRAY-513412 affects Go html/template before 1.20. 10 critical hits. Templates may allow XSS via backtick-delimited JS strings. Upgrade text/template and html/template to Go 1.21.x+.

recommendations.title: Remediate XRAY-521541/521542/521544 — Go cgo arbitrary code execution at build time
recommendations.description: Three XRAY IDs (521541, 521542, 521544) cover Go cgo build-time code execution. 10 critical hits each in liquid-go-remote-cache. Enforce go build with CGO_ENABLED=0 in CI pipelines and upgrade Go toolchain to 1.21.x.

recommendations.title: Re-evaluate disabled curation policies: jml-mlops-HF and jml-mlops-npm
recommendations.description: Two curation policies scoped to specific repos are currently disabled. Confirm this is intentional. If the ML/MLops repos are still in use, re-enable these policies to prevent high-CVE packages from entering the ML pipeline.

recommendations.title: Extend Global-Watch coverage to uncovered local repos
recommendations.description: Current watch covers 23 of 22 local repositories (54.5% coverage). Identify the 10 uncovered local repos and add them to Global-Watch or a new dedicated watch to ensure full Xray scanning.

recommendations.title: Resolve 9 Unknown license violations
recommendations.description: 9 license violations this week are classified as 'Unknown' — packages lack SPDX identifiers. Run jf xr audit on affected repos, add license properties via Artifactory, and consider adding a curation policy to block packages with no license declaration.

recommendations.title: Enable Go ecosystem curation coverage
recommendations.description: All 8 Go curation events this week were passed (0 blocked). Existing curation policies block npm and Maven packages effectively, but Go packages are passing through. Evaluate adding a Go-specific curation policy or extend scope of existing policies to cover golang.org packages.
